name: SEQUENTIAL_ALGORITHMIC_ANCHORING
description: Replaced the algebraic formulas with a direct incompatibility constraint, satisfying the expert critique and fixing the task drift. To defeat the remaining models, the problem is framed as a "strict sequential pipeline" that processes items in order 1 to n. This psychological anchor strongly biases LLMs to write sequential backtracking (e.g., `solve(index)`) rather than the degree-ordered backtracking they use for graph coloring, causing them to Time Limit Exceed on hard instances.
